json_schema_metadata_note: `$schema` and `$id` identify this machine-readable design spike/prototype. The artifact is not yet an executable validator or native SCM runtime implementation.
title: BespokeScmVirtualMaterializationPlan
description: W4-003 design spike/prototype for mapping a content-addressed WorkAreaTree into reversible materialized files during the ADR-0518 ISOLATE/AUTHOR stages, without claiming native virtual filesystem runtime availability.

governance_registration.required_update_policy: Any materialization mapping, reversibility, fixture, or claim-boundary change MUST update this plan, its root-hub pointer, and artifact-capabilities registry row in the same PR.

_meta.purpose: Lock the virtual materialization seam before runtime implementation: map WorkAreaTree content-addressed nodes to concrete repo-relative file views, journal edits, and reverse the view back into a new WorkAreaTree/content frame.

can_claim_now: The repository has a W4 design spike/prototype contract for virtual materialization from a content-addressed WorkAreaTree to materialized files.

The prototype names the required inputs, deterministic mapping steps, reversible journal fields, and RED/GREEN fixtures for round-tripping a materialized view back to content-addressed work-area identity.
The seam is compatible with ADR-0520 transitional implementations behind a stable interface and ADR-0518 ISOLATE(virtual)/AUTHOR stage boundaries.
cannot_claim_yet: bespoke SCM storage server or lease scheduler availability
object-store production durability or runtime throughput
automatic authoring/remediation or CD propagation readiness

work_area_tree.rule: Materialization consumes stable WorkAreaTree vocabulary only; parser internals and bridge git checkout paths are not materialization authority.

work_area_hash.rule: The materialization session subject MUST carry `work_area_hash`; downstream SCM change id, buck2/RBE key, and CD artifact hash remain byte-identical aliases.

object_store.rule: File bytes and large tree payloads are retrieved/stored by content-addressed object references behind the object-store-kernel seam; host temp paths are never source identity.

scm_facts.source: ADR-0526 ScmFactsSource seam or bridge snapshot
scm_facts.rule: Tracked-path universe, revision provenance, executable bits, generated-source flags, and ignored/untracked exclusions come from scm-facts evidence, not ambient filesystem walking.

rules: requested_view_mode is one of read_only_snapshot, writable_overlay, gate_replay_snapshot.
lease_ref is required for writable_overlay and every AUTHOR round-trip.

materialized_entry.path_rule: repo_relative_path is normalized POSIX, sorted lexicographically, never absolute, and never contains `..`, backslashes, control characters, or generated output unless scm-facts marks it materializable.
materialized_entry.materialized_path_token_rule: A runtime may choose a host path or virtual inode, but the contract stores only an opaque token plus reverse_mapping_ref; host paths are diagnostics only and excluded from content identity.

overlay_journal.rule: AUTHOR edits append deterministic journal entries against materialized_path_token/reverse_mapping_ref; the new WorkAreaTree frame is derived from journal content, not host filesystem metadata.

output_record.handoff_stage: AUTHOR emits a new content-addressed frame for GATE; unchanged sessions preserve result_work_area_hash == base_work_area_hash.

deterministic_mapping_steps.description: Resolve input work_area_hash to a WorkAreaTree root and scm-facts snapshot; reject if the byte-identical work-area alias is missing or divergent.
Traverse child_ids from root in canonical source order and emit sorted repo-relative MaterializedPathEntry records for file-like leaves plus required directories/tombstones.
Fetch raw bytes through object-store CAS refs; never treat a bridge checkout, mtime, or untracked file as source authority.
Create opaque materialized_path_token or virtual inode records for every entry; host paths are local diagnostics and excluded from hashes.
Record writes/deletes/renames/chmod/symlink updates as deterministic overlay journal entries tied to reverse_mapping_ref and lease_ref.
Apply the overlay journal to the base materialized manifest, normalize paths and metadata, store new bytes through CAS, and construct the result WorkAreaTree frame.
Emit evidence that materialized files round-trip to the expected WorkAreaTree frame and that forbidden ambient inputs did not participate.

reversibility_invariants.rule: Every materialized path entry MUST carry reverse_mapping_ref back to work_area_node_id or a declared tombstone/generated-output refusal.
Round-tripping an untouched materialized view MUST reproduce the exact base_work_area_hash.
A writable overlay MUST produce result_work_area_hash from canonical frame bytes, not from host path, mtime, ctime, atime, username, process id, or branch name.
Generated outputs are read-through only unless a generated-artifact control-plane row authorizes materialization; hand-edited generated JSON remains forbidden.
Materialization does not grant merge authority; GATE/ATTEST/INTEGRATE still require ADR-0515 oya-ci-required and the ADR-0518 downstream envelopes.

overlay_journal.reason: generated artifacts require control-plane regeneration rather than hand edit

acceptance_fixtures.description: A three-entry WorkAreaTree fixture maps to materialized path entries, records one accepted write and one generated-output refusal, then emits a new result_work_area_hash with roundtrip evidence.
A read-only snapshot or writable overlay with no journal entries round-trips to the exact base_work_area_hash.
Any materialization frame that includes absolute path, mtime, ctime, atime, username, pid, branch name, or untracked file content violates VMAT-REV-003.
A materialized path entry without reverse_mapping_ref cannot be reversed into a WorkAreaTree node/tombstone and violates VMAT-REV-001.
A direct write to a generated JSON materialized entry without a regeneration control-plane authorization violates VMAT-REV-004.

implementation_slices.description: Add a std-only oya-bespoke-scm-virtual-materialization-kernel crate with input/output records, entry validation, and overlay journal traits; no runtime mount.
Promote these RED/GREEN fixtures into a Rust cloud-ci gate or source-only Python checker until the Rust gate lands.
Implement a bridge adapter that projects a Git checkout/scm-facts snapshot into the same records for parity testing only; it must not become destination SCM authority.
Implement native virtual filesystem/materialization runtime after W2 parser, object-store, lease, and native SCM storage prerequisites are ready behind their stable interfaces.

verification_commands: inline Python structural assertions: 7 deterministic steps, 5 reversibility invariants, 5 acceptance fixtures, required root-hub pointer, and artifact registry row
